body.condition: For every \(\vartheta\in\Theta\), \(\operatorname{Var}_P(Y-\vartheta D\mid X=x)\ge v\) for Lebesgue-almost every \(x\in[c_P-1/8,c_P+1/8]\).

standard.name: Null-residual variance nondegeneracy on a bounded inversion set, a direct specialization of the condition used to studentize \(Y-cD\)
